        {"source": "spice", "quote": "R16 +3V3 0 1k"},
        {"source": "spec", "quote": "| R1, R2 | 10k, 5.1k | Bias/divider from `/TXD2` into Q2's base. |"}
      ],
      "impact": "A permanent 3.3 mA drain on the 3V3 rail, which wastes battery power and loads the 3V3 regulator. It is not expected to stop the board from working, but it is an unexplained load that deviates from the intended design.",
      "confidence": 0.6
    },
    {
      "category": "missing_component",
      "components": ["C5"],
      "pins": ["U1.8"],
      "nets": ["+3V3", "GND"],
      "observed": "No 0.1 µF capacitor is present in the netlist or the SPICE deck. The +3V3 net connects only to J1.11, J2.11, Q2.E, R1, R16, R6, R8 and U1.VCC, with no decoupling capacitor to GND.",
      "expected": "The specification lists C5 (0.1 µF) as the decoupling capacitor on +3V3 for the MAX3485 supply.",
      "evidence": [
        {"source": "spec", "quote": "| C5 | 0.1 µF | Decoupling cap on `+3V3` (MAX3485 supply). |"},
        {"source": "netlist", "quote": "(net (code \"1\") (name \"+3V3\") (class \"Default\")"}
      ],
      "impact": "The MAX3485 transceiver's supply is not decoupled, which can make the RS-485 half-duplex link unreliable on fast edges or when the supply is noisy.",
      "confidence": 0.4
    }
  ],
  "summary": "The netlist is largely consistent with the specification, but it contains an unexplained 1k resistor (R16) from the 3V3 rail to GND that the specification does not mention. It also lacks the 0.1 µF decoupling capacitor C5 that the specification places on +3V3."
}
